BiblicalUsage: Vermilion is the red paint of pride and idolatry. The adulteress in Ezekiel sees men portrayed upon the wall, images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion, and increases her whoredoms; the man who builds himself a wide house has it ceiled with cedar and painted with vermilion. The colour is beauty used for sin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe vermilion preaches that beauty can serve idols, for painted walls and painted houses show it, and I hold that the heart that paints them is the thing God judges.
